learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the naming words of grammar and learn how to sort them into different fun categories!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Nouns are the ultimate naming words! Everything you can see, touch, or feel has a name, whether it is a person, place, animal, thing, or even an idea.
Common nouns are general names like 'boy' or 'city'. Proper nouns are special, specific names like 'Rahul' or 'Mumbai', and they always start with a capital letter!
Sometimes things travel in groups! Collective nouns give a single name to a group of things, like a 'flock' of birds, a 'team' of players, or an 'army' of ants.
Material nouns name physical substances like 'gold', 'wood', or 'water'. Abstract nouns name invisible things you can only feel or think about, like 'happiness', 'bravery', or 'truth'.

fun_activity.title: 🏠 The Great Noun Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your house and write down 2 Proper nouns, 2 Common nouns, 2 Material nouns, and 2 Abstract nouns you can observe or think about!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nouns are naming words used for people, places, animals, things, and ideas.
⭐ We can classify nouns into five main types: Proper, Common, Collective, Material, and Abstract.
